data.name: Free Video Converter
data.detailed_description:
Free Video Converter is a feature-rich, user-friendly professional video conversion tool designed to solve all your challenges related to video format compatibility, device playback, file compression, and everyday editing tasks. Whether you need smooth playback on phones, tablets, or TVs, or seek to meet specific requirements for work presentations, content creation, or course production, it serves as your reliable digital assistant.

Key Features

Support for over 1000 formats: Covers nearly all mainstream video/audio formats (e.g., MP4, AVI, MOV, MKV, WMV, FLV) and is continuously updated

High-speed lossless conversion: Utilizes advanced hardware acceleration technology (including GPU acceleration), increasing conversion speed by up to 5 times while preserving original video and audio quality to the greatest extent

Minimalist interface: Simply drag and drop files to start—clear and intuitive workflow, easy for beginners to master quickly

Batch processing: Supports adding and converting multiple files simultaneously, saving time and effort
